jobInfo.jobDescription:
Thank you for considering employment in the Lunenburg Public Schools.
There is a long term sub position at the Lunenburg Middle/High (High) School

TITLE:  Long term Substitute - Lunenburg Middle/High School
LOCATON:  Lunenburg Middle/High School, Lunenburg, MA  01462
FUNDING SOURCE:  Local funds 
REPORTS TO:  Principal

GENERAL
.

QUALIFICATIONS & REQUIREMENTS
Appropriate Massachusetts Educator License required 
Three years of experience, preferred.
Demonstrated experience working collaboratively with administration and team members.
Strong communications skills; verbal and non-verbal.
 
START DATE:  November 30th - January 19th

RATES OF PAY
Substitute Position & Rate
Teacher Substitute (days)  $  112.00
LT Substitute--16-40 days  $  127.00
LT Substitute-41+ days       $ 260.00
